Fish Report for 11-25-2026

Nonoguchi 10-day

11-25-2026
Shogun Office Staff
https://www.shogunsportfishing.com/

We couldn't have asked for better weather or better fishing. Another great trip in the books. Thank you to Kevin Nonoguchi for hosting a great charter and Thanks Captain Connor Shanahan for putting us on the fish. 



If you would like to go fishing with us please BOOK ONLINE or call (619) 226-8030 to get in on the action.
